crossRefs.note: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yes also, the heart of the sons of…
You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.” ’
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

translations.web: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
translations.bsb: A wicked man writhes in pain all his days; only a few years are reserved for the ruthless.
translations.kjv: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
translations.asv: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, Even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
